title: Second-generation Audio Processing Toolkit
summary: The historical Python scripts are a research corpus. The ooRexx toolkit standardizes processor meaning, configuration, sample contracts, shifts, masks, measurements, feature maps, streaming profiles, graphs and results rather than transliterating script structure.
invariants: There is deliberately no universal best enhancer.
Multiple methods and parameter sets may produce parallel derived views.
FFT/NumPy operations are implementation details; semantic shifts, masks, measurements and derived material are project objects.
Processor identity is independent of CPU, native, Python, Torch or GPU execution placement.
